Chat Markdown — Real-Estate QA Demo

8 sample conversations covering all 27 CommonMark + GFM tags, rendered inside the real chat surfaces from chat-design-system.md: desktop floating popover (§5.16) on the left, mobile bottom sheet (§5.7) on the right. The markdown content is identical across both; only the bubble tokens (font-size / padding / radius) differ — see chat-markdown-spec.md §3.

👤 user bubble = plain text (no markdown rendering) 🤖 assistant bubble = rendered markdown via marked@18 + DOMPurify
